parameters.componentSubtitle: A single Bootstrap JS tab's content pane, meant to be placed inside a Tabs component.

description.component: Renders a single tab-pane element. Place it alongside its paired Tab Item in the same Tabs component — they're paired automatically by position, no Pane ID needs to be set.

pane_id.name: Pane ID
pane_id.description: Optional — leave empty to auto-generate. tabs.js always assigns this pane's live id, paired with its Tab Item by position.

is_active.name: Active
is_active.description: Whether this pane is the current/visible one.
